scope: JDK 21 standard ImageIO reader formats were inspected. Required readers are BMP, GIF, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, and WBMP; PNM, PPM, PGM, and PBM are not listed. java.io and java.nio.file expose bytes but do not interpret PNM headers or pixels. A bare-JDK ImageIO probe on the valid ASCII PPM control checks the local runtime independently from third-party plugins.
